verdict: AMD's revenue grew 38% to $10.3B as Data Center sales jumped 57% on AI demand, and net income nearly doubled to $1.4B.

segments.name: Data Center
segments.note: EPYC server processors and Instinct AI accelerators — up 57% as AI data centers kept buying; the segment earned $1.6B of operating profit.

segments.name: Client
segments.note: Ryzen processors for PCs — up 26% on strong demand and continued market-share gains.

segments.name: Gaming
segments.note: Graphics cards and console chips — up 11% on solid Radeon GPU demand, partly offset by lower semi-custom console revenue.

segments.name: Embedded
segments.note: Chips built into cars, industrial gear and communications equipment (the Xilinx business) — up 6% as demand strengthened across several markets.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Designing the next generations of CPUs, GPUs and AI accelerators — up 39% YoY.

opex.name: Marketing, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling products and running the company.

opex.name: Amortization of acquisition intangibles
opex.note: Writing down the value of technology bought in acquisitions (Xilinx above all) — a bookkeeping charge, not cash.

takeaways.title: Data Center is the engine
takeaways.text: Data Center brought in $5.8B — 56% of all revenue — and $1.6B of segment operating profit, as AI inference demand lifted both EPYC server chips and Instinct accelerators.

takeaways.title: Gross margin widened
takeaways.text: Gross margin reached 53%, up from 50% a year ago, as high-value data-center products became a bigger share of the mix.

takeaways.title: Cash piled up
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $2,566M — 25% of revenue — taking cash and short-term investments to $12.3B against just $3.2B of debt.

oneTimers: An $11M profit from discontinued operations sits below the continuing-operations line; profit from continuing operations was $1,372M.
Other income includes $66M of net gains on long-term investments (per the cash-flow statement) — paper gains, not cash from selling chips.
otherDetail: Other income of $165M plus $6M of equity income and an $11M profit from discontinued operations, less $37M of interest expense — a net +$145M.
